page.overview:
Who is Ace?

The woman by the codename "Ace" was a member of the third group to call themselves the Royal Flush Gang. She joined the group with her brother Ten after being recruited by King. The group was short lived though because, while preparing to fight Superman, King disrespected Ten by smacking him with a cane and insulting him, causing Ace to come to his rescue and surrender the fight to the Kryptonian in order to beat up the rest of the Gang.

Ace and the other members of the Royal Flush Gang were then apprehended by the police.
